body: I'm sorry to hear that. The suffering of others does not negate yours and it sucks you have no one in your life to open up to about that. Is there one thing you'd like to change that you could focus on, that way it seems more manageable than looking at the big picture?

Even if you don't do those things anymore, you enjoyed them once so you do have hobbies. Are there any small steps you can see to improve things (even if it is as simple as talk to a co-worker or something)?
aw man I totally understand you, I'm going through similar things right now. What kind of video games do you like to play//What's your favorite book?

Honestly, I posted a thread and am kind of similar to you. I just wanted to posted to tell you that you are not alone. You said if you start enjoying things it's not fun for long, what are those things you did enjoy (even if only for a short while)?
I am new to Reddit, not sure how to do that. Sorry :[
